source: T-234/D-204: partial-block cases for DSTU 7624:2014 (draft) §12.2/§12.5 semantics - a non-aligned AAD (O) and ciphertext (C) are each padded per annex Б.2 (a 1 bit, i.e. 0x80, then zeros) and the length block carries the TRUE bit lengths |O|, |C|. No annex example has a byte-level partial block (В.8.1.3 is a 139-bit GMAC example; it pins the O side and is checked by a unit test inside hazmat::kalyna_gmac). Tags generated in two independent ways that agree on all 60 scratch cases: (1) Bouncy Castle bcprov-jdk18on 1.85 KGMac as the GF(2^l) Horner chain over the pre-padded O*||C* (already block-aligned, so BC's own zero padding does not apply), with the length block swapped via tag = E(B xor lambda); (2) the same lambda swap over the pre-T-234 hazmat chain. Ciphertexts come from the CTR keystream, which matches every annex В.8 example. Not produced by the code under test. Key = 00 01 02 ..., AAD byte i = i xor 0x5A, plaintext byte i = i xor 0xC3. Full-block (q = l) tags.
